items.groupByClientOnly: Grouping is available in client mode only
items.note: Cell editing (double-click / Enter), range selection, and copy & paste are supported (M3). "Client" fetches all rows at once and performs sort/filter/paging in the browser (BantoGrid). "Server" runs sort/filter/paging in the DataProvider (InMemory in a standalone browser; Rust + SQLite via REST/SSE for Tauri / LAN browsers), and rows are lazily fetched block by block as you scroll (M5). Changes from other clients are reflected automatically via SSE / Tauri events (M6). M5: client mode supports grouping and aggregation (grouping is client mode only; server-mode grouping is planned). CSV export / import (M15): export downloads all rows reflecting the current display mode's sort/filter. Import is available to editors and above; rows with an id column are updated and rows without one are created (if any single row errors, the whole batch is rolled back).

dashboard.aboutNote: A dashboard aggregated from the product data ({count} records) (M4). In addition to line, bar, pie, and scatter charts, the combo (bar + line), radar, heatmap, and gauge are all from-scratch SVG implementations in @banto/charts (v2). The "Chart extensions (M24)" section's stacked area (updates by category, stacked) and Gantt (inventory schedule) are also demos of the new @banto/charts chart types added in M24. The docking layout below is a demo of split, tabbing, and drag rearrangement powered by @banto/dock-svelte (M8). The toolbar's "SPC" and "Trend" panels demo the M13 additions (histogram, Pareto chart, box plot, SVG export, zoom/pan, threshold bands, secondary Y axis, streaming updates).

backup.heading: Backup / restore
backup.note: Creates an online backup in the backups/ directory next to the DB file (VACUUM INTO, safe while running). Restore verifies the uploaded/selected file (integrity check + schema check), stages it, and applies it automatically at the next startup (it never swaps the running DB). The current DB just before applying is backed up automatically (spec M17).

{source}
